tldr: 台股週二（8/11）上漲191.96點收45,120.72點、重返4萬5關卡，台積電漲15元至2,395元撐盤，投資人選股不追高，等待美國通膨數據。
台積電上修2026美元營收成長至「略高於40%」，AI相關營收估破兆元、訂單能見度直達2028年。
金管會對合庫信用卡缺失開罰，並鬆綁金控共同行銷與子公司減資規範。
8月高股息ETF除息潮登場，00878配息1.01元創新高，8月18日除息。

items.title_zh: 台股收漲191點重回4萬5 台積電撐盤
items.title_en: Taiex adds 192 points to reclaim 45,000 as TSMC holds gains
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週二（8/11）上漲191.96點、收45,120.72點，漲幅0.43%，成交值8,690億元，重返45,000點大關。台積電上漲15元至2,395元撐住盤面，惟追價買盤轉趨謹慎，多方在美國本週通膨數據公布前維持震盪整理，本波反彈格局尚未受到破壞。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index rose 191.96 points on Tuesday (Aug 11) to close at 45,120.72, up 0.43%, on turnover of NT$869bn, reclaiming the 45,000 mark. TSMC gained NT$15 to NT$2,395 and anchored the index even as traders turned cautious about chasing highs, keeping the current rebound intact ahead of key US inflation data due later this week.

items.title_zh: AI、PCB族群獲買盤青睞 台積電盤中再創高
items.title_en: AI and PCB names draw buying as TSMC sets fresh intraday high
items.summary_zh: 台積電週二盤中再度改寫盤中新高，資金輪動流向AI伺服器供應鏈與PCB類股，科技權值續居盤面核心。高速板、先進封裝與散熱相關個股吸引買盤進駐，使參與面由晶圓代工龍頭向外擴散；惟整體成交顯示投資人選股不追高，操作維持相對審慎。
items.summary_en: Buying rotated into AI-server supply names and PCB makers on Tuesday as TSMC briefly set a new intraday high, keeping technology heavyweights at the center of the market. Advanced-packaging, high-speed board and cooling-related plays attracted funds, broadening participation beyond the foundry leader, though overall turnover showed investors staying selective rather than chasing the whole board higher.

items.title_zh: 台積電上修2026美元營收成長至逾4成 AI需求「極強」
items.title_en: TSMC lifts 2026 dollar-revenue guidance toward the mid-40s% as AI demand stays "extremely strong"
items.summary_zh: 台積電將2026年美元營收成長目標由「逾30%」上修至「略高於40%」，形容AI需求極其強勁，主要來自雲端業者及其下游客戶。法人估AI相關營收可望突破400億美元、跨過新台幣兆元大關，訂單能見度已延伸至2028年，先進製程與封裝產能持續滿載，支撐全年成長動能。
items.summary_en: TSMC has guided 2026 US-dollar revenue growth to "slightly above 40%," up from an earlier "over 30%," describing AI demand as extremely strong and led by cloud service providers. Analysts see AI-related revenue topping US$40bn and crossing the NT$1tn mark, with order visibility now extending to 2028 as advanced-node and packaging capacity remains fully booked.

items.title_zh: 記憶體、被動元件搭上AI上升循環
items.title_en: Memory and passive-component makers ride the AI-driven upcycle
items.summary_zh: 記憶體、被動元件與矽晶圓族群延續回溫，AI伺服器與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求帶動供給趨緊、價格轉強，漲勢擴散至整體科技供應鏈。此波動能顯示AI資本支出循環正把台灣硬體供應鏈更廣泛族群拉進上升軌道，從DRAM、NAND到板類與電源管理元件皆受惠資料中心建置需求延伸。
items.summary_en: Memory chipmakers, passive-component and silicon-wafer suppliers extended a recovery as AI-server and high-bandwidth-memory demand tightened supply and firmed pricing across the technology chain. The strength signals the AI capital-spending cycle is pulling a broader slice of Taiwan's hardware supply chain into the upturn, from DRAM and NAND names to boards and power-management components feeding data-center buildouts.

items.title_zh: 金管會對合庫信用卡疑義帳款開罰 並公布6月卡務與電支數據
items.title_en: FSC fines Taiwan Cooperative Bank over credit-card disputed-charge lapses; releases June card and e-payment data
items.summary_zh: 金管會8月11日發布對合作金庫商業銀行辦理信用卡疑義帳款作業缺失的行政處分，同時公布115年6月份信用卡、現金卡及電子支付機構業務資訊。此舉凸顯主管機關持續聚焦消費者保護內控與支付產業透明度，因應信用卡與電子支付使用規模持續擴大下的監理要求。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission on Aug 11 published an administrative sanction against Taiwan Cooperative Bank for deficiencies in handling disputed credit-card charges, and released June statistics for credit cards, cash cards and electronic-payment institutions. The actions underscore the regulator's continued focus on consumer-protection controls and payment-sector transparency as card and e-payment usage keeps expanding.

items.title_zh: 金管會鬆綁金控共同行銷與子公司減資規範
items.title_en: FSC eases holding-company rules on cross-marketing and subsidiary capital reduction
items.summary_zh: 金管會8月7日修正金融機構合作推廣他業商品或提供相關服務規範，並修正「金融控股公司之子公司間共同行銷管理辦法」及「金融控股公司之子公司減資辦法」相關條文。此番調整旨在給予金融集團更多營運彈性，同時維持銀行、保險與證券子公司在行為規範與資本面的防護機制，兼顧監理與市場競爭。
items.summary_en: The regulator on Aug 7 amended rules governing joint promotion and cross-sale of other firms' products by financial institutions, and revised provisions on cross-marketing among financial-holding subsidiaries and on subsidiary capital-reduction procedures. The changes aim to give financial groups more operating flexibility while maintaining conduct and capital safeguards across bank, insurance and securities arms.

items.title_zh: 8月高股息ETF除息潮 00878配息1.01元創掛牌新高
items.title_en: August high-yield ETF ex-dividend wave: 00878 declares record NT$1.01 payout
items.summary_zh: 國泰永續高股息（00878）本期每受益權單位配息1.01元、創掛牌以來新高，除息日訂於8月18日，最晚須於8月17日前買進方可參與。8月共32檔台股ETF（30檔股票型加2檔債券型）接力除息，集中在4日至25日，替偏好現金流的投資人排出密集的領息行事曆，惟仍須留意填息表現。
items.summary_en: Cathay Sustainability High Dividend ETF (00878) set a record distribution of NT$1.01 per unit this period, with its ex-dividend date on Aug 18 and the last buy-in day Aug 17. It headlines a busy August in which 32 Taiwan ETFs (30 equity plus 2 bond funds) go ex-dividend, clustered between the 4th and 25th, giving income-focused investors a dense calendar to navigate.

items.title_zh: 高殖利率誘人但填息才是關鍵 00881、00923、00961同列8月配息
items.title_en: High yields tempt but filling the gap matters: 00881, 00923, 00961 among August payers
items.summary_zh: 除00878外，本月多檔ETF端出亮眼年化殖利率，包括國泰台灣科技龍頭（00881）預估配息4.6元、群益台ESG低碳50（00923）年化殖利率近15%、FT臺灣永續高息（00961）約17.5%。理財專家提醒，高配息不等於高報酬，除息後的填息速度與長期績效才是決定實質收益的關鍵，投資人應避免只看配息率。
items.summary_en: Beyond 00878, several ETFs flagged eye-catching annualized yields this month, including Cathay Taiwan Tech Leaders (00881) at an estimated NT$4.6 payout, Capital Taiwan ESG Low-Carbon 50 (00923) near a 15% yield, and FT Taiwan Sustainable High Dividend (00961) around 17.5%. Advisers caution that headline yield is not total return—post-ex-dividend price recovery and long-term performance still drive outcomes.
